item.title: Sprout 0.1.2
item.description:
Sprout 0.1.2

  • More colour, each with one meaning: orange while data comes in, green while it goes out, amber while waiting or checking, red for errors.
  • A finished download blooms: a green sweep through its progress dots, and DONE for a moment.
  • The Dock icon's seedling grows as your downloads progress, and flowers when one finishes.
  • A leaf marks torrents that have shared back as much as they downloaded.
  • Haptic feedback on Force Touch trackpads when you drop a torrent or switch to slower speeds.
  • A couple of hidden surprises in the dots.

item.title: Sprout 0.1.1
item.description:
Sprout 0.1.1

  • Runs on Intel Macs as well as Apple silicon.
  • Runs on macOS 26. The engine in 0.1.0 needed macOS 27.
  • Updates itself: Sprout checks once a day, and Sprout › Check for Updates… checks now.
  • A new app icon, and the About window lists the included software and its licences.
  • Deleted files go to the Trash, with a switch in Settings › Downloads.
  • Fixes from hands-on testing: readable selected rows, ⌘F for the filter, a steadier list, clearer settings and dialogs.
